name: – Recital B
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the impact of the Turkish invasion on Cypriot women and girls, and the crimes committed by Turkish forces and consequences on gender equality
part_text: whereas the occupying regime, which is a result of the 1974 Turkish invasion and is subordinate to Türkiye, is illegal and is not internationally recognised; whereas the perpetrators of the gender-based violence were predominantly members of the Turkish armed forces, who were reportedly acting at the direction of and/or under the protection of their officers;
